Game Overview

In Putot 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an adventurous quest in Putot 2, navigating through eight increasingly challenging 2D levels. Master the art of double jumping to outmaneuver alien foes and treacherous obstacles. Explore every hidden corner to uncover treasures, while deftly dodging spikes, lasers, and relentless enemies. A thrilling test of agility and cunning awaits!
